title: Almost every modular orbit avoids a prescribed measurable null set
statement: Let G = SL₂(ℤ) act on ℍ by Möbius transformations, and equip ℍ with its Borel measurable structure and hyperbolic measure μ = dx dy/y². For every measurable set S ⊆ ℍ satisfying μ(S) = 0, for μ-almost every z ∈ ℍ and every a ∈ G, one has a • z ∉ S.
lean_statement: ∀ s : Set UpperHalfPlane, MeasurableSet s → (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane) s = 0 → ∀ᵐ z ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure UpperHalfPlane), ∀ a : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, a • z ∉ s
